user_reported_bug: User wants a UI button (instead of DevTools console) to renumber an invoice — filling audit gaps caused by pre-soft-delete hard-deletions. Also wants safety checks so it doesn't recur with proforma conversions.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused UI verification logged in as arjuna@mddrc.com.my, opened Finance > Invoices, and confirmed invoices render but zero [data-testid^='renumber-invoice-'] buttons are visible in the normal login flow. localStorage after login contains token only and no user key, while InvoicesTab gates the button from localStorage.user.role, so the dialog/submission flow is unreachable.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin-only renumber '#' buttons are not visible for the logged-in admin user because InvoicesTab reads role from localStorage.getItem('user'), but login/App only stores localStorage token and never stores user.

integration_issues.flow: Login as admin -> Finance -> Invoices -> Renumber Invoice
integration_issues.issue: After successful login, localStorage was {'token': 'present', 'user': null}; Finance invoices loaded, but renumber buttons count was 0, so dialog fields, submit enablement, success refresh, and duplicate-number toast could not be exercised through the user-visible UI.

action_items: Fix admin role detection for InvoicesTab: pass the authenticated user/role as a prop or persist/refresh localStorage.user consistently on login and auth/me, and clear it on logout.
Add super_admin to the /finance ProtectedRoute allowedRoles if Super Admins must access Finance directly as required.
Retest the full renumber UI after the button is visible: dialog fields, disabled/enabled submit, successful renumber list refresh, duplicate-number error toast, and proforma exclusion.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/App.js handleLogin stores only localStorage.setItem('token', token); it does not store localStorage.user. InvoicesTab.jsx lines 29-31 depend on localStorage.user.role, making isAdmin false after normal login.

frontend/src/App.js /finance route allows only ['finance', 'admin']; the requirement says Admin/Super Admin, so a true super_admin user would be redirected away from Finance before reaching the Invoices tab.
The current test DB had 11 finance invoices and document_type_counts={'<missing>': 11}; no live proforma row was available to verify proforma exclusion through the UI.

success_rate.backend: not tested in this frontend-only iteration; supporting API login/invoice fetch worked for admin and coordinator invoice fetch correctly returned 403
success_rate.frontend: 0% for the requested renumber UI because the required button is absent in normal user flow

Existing test invoices include INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0004, INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0003, and INV/MDDRC/2099/12/8313.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: clear localStorage, login as arjuna, navigate to /finance, open Invoices. Finance invoices render, but no orange '#' renumber buttons appear. Root cause from code review: InvoicesTab computes isAdmin from localStorage.user.role, but App.js never writes a user key to localStorage after login or auth/me, so isAdmin is false even for the authenticated admin.
